metrics.also_reported_no_verdict: per-task success, grasped-right and place-given-grasp per task and arm, both layouts, N3 minus mean(N1,N2) per arm
metrics.labelled: development read on N2 main states 4-23, existing rollouts, familiar layout; frozen GR00T (n2_roll/groot_main, sc_t1/groot_r2, groot_r10) and pi0.5 at 2 and 10 actions per query (sc_t1/pi05_r2, pi05_r10); one seed per arm
metrics.mapping: Groups by task object in n2_tasks.json: cream cheese (N1-N3) vs wine bottle (N4-N6). Per arm, gap = mean success(bottle) - mean success(cheese); CI by bootstrap over states (2000 draws, seed 0), states resampled jointly across tasks, tasks fixed. HOLDS iff CI lower > 0; REVERSED iff CI upper < 0; else UNCLEAR. Overall: SUPPORTED iff GR00T's pooled arm (the three GR00T files averaged) HOLDS and no registered arm is REVERSED; REFUTED iff GR00T's pooled arm is REVERSED; else UNRESOLVED
metrics.prediction: SUPPORTED: every arm HOLDS; GR00T's gap smaller in absolute size than pi0.5's because its level is near the floor
metrics.seen_before_registration: pi0.5 intact (n2_roll/pi05_main) per-task values were seen before registration (RIVAL_TESTS 3.1) and are descriptive only; GR00T's and the r2/r10 per-task values were not seen
